column1: # The 1619 locator-like words the RTTI sweep refused, named at last.
# Produced by scripts/Ac6RttiRejects.java, read-only, no oracle. It re-runs
# SweepMsvcRtti's identical scan - same 811 vtables, same 1619 refusals -
# and records which step of the chain refused each candidate.
# reason is the first step that failed, in the sweep's own order:
# Not one candidate reached the vtable test. Every refusal happened on the
# name, which is to say the word never pointed at a type descriptor at all,
# so no class was lost to this filter.
# name_bytes is the hex of whatever the sweep read where a decorated name
# should be, and empty when it could not be read at all. It is binary, and
# columns: at target reason block name_bytes following_word
